notes.value:
Poem of 24 lines on the troubles caused in Amsterdam by the return of Heyn with the Silver fleet.

Author's name from Alden.

There are 2 other editions, probably of the same year. In this edition, line 11 reads "Giert wtebruyt die strong mit smart."

Imprint from Alden.

Printed on a quarter sheet.

Bibliotheca Americana: catalogue of the John Carter Brown Library in Brown University, Providence, Rhode Island, 2:218-219.

European Americana 629/154.

title: Op het onset van Piet Heyns buyt, het VVest-Injes-Huys spreeckt
